requested_scope: Official NH regional agricultural/livestock cooperative staffed-branch listings in Jeonbuk, plus NH and CU neighboring-province context candidates.
temporal_interpretation: October retrieval is an expanded current-listing sensitivity scenario. August 2026 existence and operating status are unknown; original source baseline is not silently replaced.

nh.discrepancy_interpretation: Two Jeonbuk-address records appear in coordinate-bounds query but not province query. Source filter cause is unknown. Use reconciled spatial candidates without calling either query a confirmed real-world census.
nh.service_interpretation: svc1=1 branch tab; svc2=2 agricultural/livestock cooperative vs svc2=1 NH Bank. No ATM/store tab queried. Individual financial-service availability/hours unverified. Economic/store-like names retained consistently when official branch category is identical and flagged for review.
nh.coordinate_interpretation: Official map setMarker arguments mapX longitude/mapY latitude. No geocoding API used. Source coordinates are not independent ground truth.
nh.duplicate_bank_handling: Current Jeonbuk NH Bank 52 records should not be appended to the frozen 52 NH Bank baseline records. Crosswalk is candidate identity evidence, not a coordinate replacement instruction.

cu.restriction_rule: Include only official uniRelTy=1 지역; exclude uniRelTy=3 직장 and hold uniRelTy=2 단체 because general access is unconfirmed. Official finder explicitly cautions workplace and some group coops restrict users.
cu.coordinate_missingness_rule: Two (0,0) source coordinates excluded from coordinate filtering; not assumed absent from target region. Their listed addresses and raw JSON are preserved.

remaining_coverage_gaps: Cross-border non-NH banks, KFCC, and financial-service post offices were not collected in this supplement. Do not claim exhaustive all-provider border coverage.
KFCC official list endpoint timed out on bounded probe; no repeated unbounded retrieval was attempted.
Current official listing does not independently verify staffed opening hours, service equivalence, accessibility, or August 2026 presence.
NH province selector omitted two current Jeonbuk-address branches present in coordinate query; unresolved source-side inconsistency.
Two CU source coordinates are (0,0), retained as unresolved source records.
integration_boundary: Root performs exact administrative polygon assignment, origin-radius border filtering, deduplication, network snapping, and scenario analysis. These source-context counts are not final added-outlet or changed-priority counts.
